title: PAD PROMPTS NAME THE BUTTONS AS BOUND
why: v26.53 CHANGE PAD BUTTONS moves the raid actions onto other buttons, and the raid reads the buttons as bound, but nine prompts a controller player (player 2 in co-op) reads were fixed Xbox names: the belt walk said RT TO DRAW, a heal with none on the belt and the HUD corner said VIEW BACKPACK, the teammate offer said [Y] TAKE, the ring said [Y] SEARCH, the open backpack said Y drop for teammate, A pick up or place, B close and DPAD move, and a stowed gun said LB OR RB TO SWAP, whatever the buttons were. Proven in headless Chromium with a fake controller and real padBind calls: after moving fire, backpack, ring search, roll, crouch and the belt walk, every one of those texts still named the old button, and Y no longer took the offer or dropped the item. Now each names the button the action is on, through pbn and keyLabel, so a PlayStation pad still reads its own names; with the standard buttons every text is word for word as before, and the Undercroft backpack line is unchanged.
now: On a controller with changed buttons, the raid prompts (draw, backpack, take, search, the backpack keys and the gun swap) name the buttons you set.
